Package com.example.cosmos_discovery.model

Class EventStats

java.lang.Object
com.example.cosmos_discovery.model.EventStats
public class EventStats extends Object
Immutable snapshot of computed statistics for a single event. Use compute(Event) to build an instance from an Event. The static factory is pure Java (no Firebase / Android deps) so it can be unit-tested directly.
